classification: The max of positive service and common delivery does not fix static SDK startup; not adopted.
common_source: Both arms include the common raw ring, conservative offer bound, safe receiver-prefix restriction, pending-drain guards and the reviewed SDK prefix test contracts.
context: Tests ran with concurrent host load and no quiescence wait. Exact load/context/timestamps remain in each run status.
interpretation: Short buffered-feedback and finite component controls pass, but these do not prove arbitrary multi-RTT feedback safety or closed-loop optimality. In the failing SDK cells final positive service exceeds the common rate; this one-line maximum cannot improve that limiter.
next_step: Trace the actual startup limiter before another controller change; retain original warmups, per-direction capacity, finite-queue and refusal gates.
performance_scope: The unchanged SDK Short passes and SDK Long fails in each arm. Long has failures in both the 100 ms and 400 ms device-default cells. All 40 service readings and 370 top-level outcomes are retained.
production_delta: Use max(ServiceByteRate, AggregateDeliveryByteRate) for pacing before existing discovery/drain margins and target cap. No sizing or backlog-classification change.
race_scope: 61 named component definitions repeated three times: 183 passes in each arm; no race warnings.
